preview.title: Okureeba, okurugiirira aha kuhinduka kuhisya v1
preview.body: Eki n'okureeba okw'ahonaaho aha API y'abanyamakuru hamwe na banywani. Tikirikubaasa kwetwa hati: enyima neetwara omu kicweka 2, kandi endagiriro, ebishushani hamwe n'ebikomo nibibaasa kuhinduka otakahikire aha muringo 1.

overview.title: Okureeba hamwe
overview.body: Zuula API neeha abanyamakuru abarikwikirizibwa hamwe n'ebitongore ebirikukwatanisa okuhamya kumwe okurikureeta amaani ga zuula.ug. Okukyebera nikugyenda omu maisho:
overview.step1: Oheereze ebirikukwata aha POST /v1/checks. Orikutunga okurondoora ID ahonaaho.
overview.step3: Shoma okusharamu, obwesigye bw'obubonero, okushoborora hamwe n'okworekwa kuruga omu birugiremu.
overview.format: JSON ahari HTTPS (UTF-8). Obwire bw'okukora ni ISO 8601 omuri UTC.

auth.title: Okuhamya
auth.body: Buri kushaba nikwetenga ekishumuruzo API omu mutwe gwa Authorization. Abanyamakuru abahamibwa hamwe n'abebembezi barabaasa kutandikaho kandi bakashazamu ebishumuruzo omuri Akawunti → API okuhikwaho. Ebishumuruzo nibitandika na zl_live_ kandi nibyorekwa omurundi gumwe.

scopes.submit: Oheereze obutumwa, emikura, ebihandiiko hamwe n'ebirikworekwa okushwijumwa.
scopes.read: Shoma ebirugire omu kushwijuma kandi osherure ebyahandiikirwe.

auth.serverOnlyTitle: Guma oine ebishumuruzo aha seva yaawe
auth.serverOnly: Otakata API key omu rupapura rwa web, app y'esimu nainga eibikiro ry'abantu boona. Teera esimu aha API kuruga aha seva yaawe kandi oihemu key yoona erikubaasa kuba yaashukire.

rate.title: Obukwakurizo bw'okushashura
rate.body: Buri kishumuruzo nikibaasa kukora {limit} okushaba buri shaaha. Buri kugarukamu nikugamba aha buremeezi bwawe obusigaireho. Ku oraakikoresa, API neegira 429 Too Many Requests: rinda omubare gw'obutikitiki omuri Retry-After otakagarukiremu.

headers.limit: Okushaba okurikwikirizibwa buri shaaha aha kishumuruzo eki.
headers.reset: Obu obuhwezi burikugaruka, nk'obwire bwa Unix omu sikonda.
headers.retryAfter: Ekoohereza n'ebigarukwamu bya 429: obutikitiki bw'okurinda otakagarukiremu.

submit.title: Heereza ceeke
submit.body: Oheereze ekintu kimwe kugira ngu kikakasibwe. Kozesa JSON aha bihandiiko, emikono hamwe n'ebihandiiko, na multipart/form-data aha fayiro z'eby'amakuru. Ekyarugamu nikihika ahonaaho n'okukuratirwa ID; okukyebera kwonka nikutwara obwire bwa 10 obw'obutikitiki bw'ebihandiiko hamwe n'obwire oburikuhika aha dakiika y'eby'amakuru.

fields.content: Ekihandiiko ky'okukyebera. Okuhika aha {textMax} enyuguta z'ekihandiiko, {articleMax} ahabw'ekihandiiko. Nikyetengwa ahabw'ebihandiiko hamwe n'ekihandiiko.
fields.url: Ekikwatireine na http nainga https ekirikugyenda aha kihandiiko ky'amahurire nainga orupapura rwa web. Nikyetengwa ahabwa url.
fields.file: Ekishushani, ekiraka nainga vidiyo, kuhika ahari {size}. JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, MP3, M4A, WAV, OGG, AAC, MP4, MOV, WebM nainga 3GP. Nikyetengwa ahabw'ebirikukwata aha by'amakuru.
fields.headline: Omutwe gw'ekicweka ogurikubaasa kutooranwa, ogurikuhika aha bunene bwa {max} obubonero.
fields.language: Orurimi rw'ebirikukwataho: en, lg, ach, nyn, teo, nainga auto kugira ngu rukimanye (ekyabuzima).

status.title: Tunga ekirugiremu
status.body: Nigaruka omu mbeera ya cheki. Obu embeera eri completed, ekishushani kya result nikikwata aha kintu kyona ekirikukyeberwa. Ebihandiiko by'okurondoora nibireebeka nka ZL-7K3P-Q9.

states.processing: Ebirikugambwa biriyo nibigyezibwa kurabira omu burugo oburikuheebwa ekitiinisa hamwe na AI-okumanya emiringo.
states.failed: Okukyebera tikurabaasize kuhwa. Ekishushani ky'enshobi nikishoboorora ahabwenki.

search.title: Ronda ebirikukyebera amazima
search.body: Ronda omu ibiikiro ry'ebitabo erya gavumenti eririmu ebihikire ebirikuhamibwa. Ebirikurugamu nibiteebwaho kurugirira aha kumanya kw'abantu hamwe n'obwire obu birikumara, kandi ebirikuheebwa ebyarugamu bikasigara bitarikushwijumwa.

factCheck.title: Okukyebera amazima
factCheck.body: Okukyebera okuhwaire hamwe n'ebirugire omu kushwijuma biine enkora egi. Ebirikuteerana nibibaasa kuba biri busha; ebicweka nibibaasa kwongyerwaho batakahikize v1 kwonka tibarikubaasa kubiihamu.

errors.body: Enshobi nizikoresa obubonero bwa HTTP hamwe n'omubiri gwa JSON ogurikushoma ekyoma code hamwe n'ogurikushoma omuntu message.

report.title: Funa okukyebera amazima
report.body: Okugarukamu ekintu kimwe ekyashohoziibwe omu kushwijuma amazima kuruga omuri ID: ebihandiiko ebirikushagika abantu boona <link>Orupapura rw'okuhayo ripoota</link>, otwariiremu okusharamu, obwesigye, okushoborora, okugamba hamwe n'okuteebereza kw'abantu.

webhooks.body: Okuteekateekwaho hamwe na API kugira ngu otakabaasa kukora okubuuza: okugarukamu aha seva yaawe obu okushwijuma kwaba kuriho. Ekicweka eki nikiija kujuzibwa bwanyima y'okutambuza obutumwa omu kicweka kya 2. Obutimba bwa Zuula aha <link>WhatsApp na Telegram</link> burikwombekwa aha byombeko bimwe.

access.title: Okutunga obushoboorozi
access.body: Abanyamakuru abahamibwa hamwe n'abebembezi barabaasa kutandikaho ekishumuruzo eriizooba omuri <keys>Akawunti → API okuhikwaho</keys>; nikiza kutandika kukora obu API eraza kuba eriho omu kicweka kya 2. Ahabw'okugaita eby'amakuru nainga okukoresa obwingi bw'omuhendo gw'ahaiguru, ohandiike <email>hello@zuula.ug</email>. Okukoresa API nikimanyisa okwikiriza <terms>API ebiragiro</terms>.

Home.subtitle: Kwata obutumwa, akakwate nainga oteho eby'amakuru. Zuula neekugambira yaaba n'obwesigwa, n'ekishuba nainga AI-ekikozirwe — kandi <scribble>nikyoreka oburugo</scribble>.

About.metaDescription: Omurimo gwa Zuula, omuringo, obwetegyeki bw'okushohoza hamwe na FAQ.

banner.title: Aha bikwatiraine
banner.description: Omurimo gwaitu, omuringo gw'okukora hamwe n'obugabe bw'abanyamakuru.

why.title: Kikombekwa omu muringo amakuru garikutamburamu omuri Yuganda.

sources.title: Oburugo obwesigwa
sources.body: Ebirikugambwa nibishwijumwa kuruga omu Uganda hamwe n'ensi yoona kandi abarikushwijuma amazima.

ai.title: AI okushanga ebirikukwata aha bintu
ai.body: Ebendera AI-ebigambo ebirikukorwa, ebishushani by'okweshushaniriza, amahurire g'okweshushaniriza hamwe n'ebishushani by'okuhindura.

languages.title: Endimi za Uganda
languages.body: Orungyereza, Oruganda, Acholi, Runyankole na Ateso.

mission.title: Uganda neereeba okushaba kw'okugumizamu buri izooba. Zuula neekubanza kureeba otakagabaniise.
mission.body: Zuula (ekirikuruga omu Uganda Fact-Guard) n'omukutu gw'okushwijuma amazima ogurikuhwerwa AI-ogwombekirwe ahabw'oku amakuru garikutambura aha — aha WhatsApp, omu kuganiira kw'ebibinja hamwe n'aha mikutu ya boona, obwire obwingi garikukira okushwijuma kw'eishengyero ry'amakuru. Heereza ekigambirwe kandi otungye encwamu erikushagikwa obujurizi, kutari kuteekateeka kwonka.

methodology.title: Oku turikuhika aha kusharamu
methodology.description: Buri kushwijuma nikukuratira emitendera ena, yaaba erikukorwa omu kyoma nari ekareetwa aha muntu orikugishwijuma.

submit.title: Waheereza okushaba kwawe
submit.body: Kwata ekihandiiko, ogabane akakwate nainga oteho eby'amahuriire (kuza kuhika ahari 50 MB). Otwara okurondoora ID kandi noobaasa kukuratira okushwijuma omu bwire obwo.

check.title: Nitukyebera
check.body: Eki barikugamba, nikigyeragyeranisibwa n'oburugo oburikwesigwa omu Uganda hamwe n'omu mahanga g'aheeru, kandi kikashwijumwa ahabw'ebihandiiko ebirikukorwa AI, deepfakes hamwe n'okuhindura amahurire nainga vidiyo.

publish.title: Ebirugire omu kooti nibishohozibwa
publish.body: Nooreeba ekyarugamu, obuhame oburi enyima yaakyo hamwe n'oburugo oburikwikirizana nainga obutarikwikirizana — tikirikukira kuba akabonero.

review.title: Abantu hamwe n'abarikushwijuma nibagira eki barikugamba
review.body: Abashomi nibagyeragyeranisa encwamu. Abantu baingi ku barikuba batarikwikirizana, omukugu ow'omugasho naashwijuma omushango kandi naabaasa kuhakana nari kuguhindura — ripoota neeba eteirweho akamanyiso ka "Human Verified."

independence.title: Ebiragiro ebi turikukuratira
independence.description: Okusharamu kwa Zuula tikurikuguzibwa, kandi tikurikuhendera hatariho omuringo gw'okukuhakanisa.

label.title: Nituteekaho ebipande, titurikushazamu
label.body: Zuula terikwihaho ekishushani ky'omuntu weena. Nitushohoza okusharamu kwetongoire hamwe n'obuhame oburikukwatanisa nakyo.

rules.title: Buri kuteera obubonero nikukuratira ebiragiro bimwe
rules.body: Abantu boona, abanyamakuru hamwe n'abakugu nibareeba aha kuguma kw'abantu omu byanga, ekirikworekwa obuhame bw'ebyafaayo — tihariho akaruuru ka muntu karikushazibwamu hatariho enshonga.

accountable.title: Abashwijumi nibajunanizibwa
accountable.body: Okuhindura okw'obukugu nikwetenga obuhame bw'okuhandiika kandi bukahandikwa omu kihandiiko ky'okushwijuma ekirikubaasa kureebwa abarikukurira.

sources.title: Oburugo nibworekwa, tibukusherekwa
sources.body: Buri ripoota neegaita obuhame obu erikukyeberwa, n'ahabw'ekyo noobaasa kushwijuma okuteekateeka kwaitu iwe wenka.

whatsapp.eyebrow: Eriija omu bwire butari bwa hare
whatsapp.title: Kyebera okushaba kuruga WhatsApp
whatsapp.description: Tihariho app, tihariho data bundle ya browser — yongyerayo obutumwa kandi otungye ekyarugamu omu kugaaniira.
whatsapp.body: A WhatsApp hamwe na Telegram bot etebekanisiibwe aha kicweka kya API, n'ahabw'ekyo noija kuba noobaasa kwohereza obutumwa butunu ahari Zuula nk'oku orikukikora aha banywani baawe. Tikiriho hati — obwahati, kozesa <link>Kikakasibwa</link> aha web.

free.a: Okukyebera okushaba hamwe n'okushoma Library n'ekya busha ahari buri omwe. Akawunti z'abanyamakuru hamwe n'abakugu nizetenga okwikirizibwa, ahabw'okuba nizitwara oburemeezi bwingi omu bubonero bw'abantu kandi nizibaasa kushwijuma emishango erikwetengwa.

submit.a: Ekihandiiko (nk'ekya WhatsApp ekirikugyenda omu maisho), akakwate, ekihandiiko kyona, nainga eby'amahurire — ebishushani, obutumwa bw'eiraka hamwe n'obutambi kuhika aha 50 MB.

time.a: Ebihandiiko buriijo nibitwara obwire bwa 10 obutikitiki. Eby'amakuru nibibaasa kutwara kuhika aha dakiika emwe. Emishango erikuhindurwa kuza omu muntu orikumanya ebirikukiraho neekuratira obwire bw'okugarukamu omu mwanya gw'ekyo.

verdicts.q: Ebirikuruga omu kucwa orubanja nibimanyisa ki?

disagree.q: Kandi shi ku ndaabe ntarikwikirizana n'encwamu?
disagree.a: Kigabire obubonero. Obubonero kuruga omu bantu, abanyamakuru hamwe n'abakugu nibugaitwa hamwe omu bubonero bw'obwesigye bw'abantu. Obubonero bw'okusharamu ku burikukyendeera kuhika aha rurengo rw'ahansi n'obubonero oburikumara, nibuteebwaho akamanyiso k'omukugu kushwijuma kandi akakakasibwa nainga akahindura.

languages.q: Ni ndimi ki ezi Zuula erikushagika?
languages.a: Okushaba nikubaasa kushwijumwa omu Rungyereza, Oruganda, Acholi, Runyankole na Ateso. Ekishushani kiriyo nikituvunuurwa omu ndimi ezo nazo; ekintu kyona ekitakavunwirwe nikireebeka omu Rungyereza.

data.a: Omu biragiro bya Uganda eby'okurinda ebihandiiko hamwe n'obuhangwa bw'abantu, 2019. Reeba <link>Ekiragiro ky'obusherekye</link> yaitu.

who.q: Noha orikwombeka kandi akata esente omuri Zuula?
who.a: Zuula (“Uganda Fact-Guard”) ekakorwa ekitongore kya Centre for Intelligent Technologies aha Victoria University Kampala nk'omurimo gw'eby'obwegyese hamwe n'okwenda kw'abantu boona. Okusharamu nikuhikwaho hatariho obuhwezi bw'omuntu weena orikugura nainga orikuranga.

contact.title: Kwatanisa
contact.description: Ebibuuzo ebirikukwata aha kusharamu, omukutu nainga okukwatanisa.

general.title: Okubuuza okwa boona
general.body: Eby'amakuru, obukwatanisa hamwe n'ebibuuzo bya puroguraamu.

privacy.metaDescription: Oku Zuula erikurundaana, okukoresa n'okurinda ebihandiiko byawe.
privacy.title: Obutamanya ebirikukukwataho
privacy.description: Oku turikurundaana, okukoresa n'okurinda ebihandiiko byawe.

overview.title: Okureeba hamwe
overview.body: Ekiragiro eki nikishoboorora eki Zuula erikurundaana waaba nookyebera okushaba, orikurambura omu Library nainga okakora akawunti, kandi oku amakuru ago garikukoresibwa kandi gakakingwa ahansi y'ebiragiro bya Ekiragiro ky'okurinda ebihandiiko hamwe n'obukwenda bw'omuntu, 2019 ebya Uganda. Nikikwata aha mukutu gwa Zuula hamwe na, ku gurikuba gwatandikirweho, obutumwa bwa WhatsApp na Telegram hamwe na abanywani ba API.

items.account: Ebirikukwata aha akawunti — eiziina, email nainga enamba y'esimu, hamwe n'omurimo (Public, Omunyamakuru, Omukugu nainga Admin).
items.submissions: Okuhayo — ekihandiiko, akakwate nainga emikutu ei orikushaba Zuula kushwijuma, hamwe n'okukuratira ID okurikuheebwa.
items.ratings: Okushwijuma n'ebihandiiko — ebyarugamu by'okuteebereza, ebiteiso by'orikureka, hamwe n'ebirikworekwa ngu birikwetengwa okukuratirwa.
items.accreditation: Ebihandiiko by'okwikiriza — ahabwa abanyamakuru hamwe n'abakugu, ebirikukwataho ebi orikuheereza kushwijumwa.
items.device: Amakuru agarikukwata aha kyoma n'okugikoresa — empapura ezirambwirwe, omuringo gwa browser hamwe n'omwanya gw'okutandikiramu, okurinda obuheereza buri obukuumi kandi burikukora.

items.pipeline: Okutambuza okushaba kurabira omu nkora yaitu y'okukyebera kandi tukworekye embeera yaakyo hamwe n'ekyarugamu.
items.ccs: Okupima n'okugaita obubonero bw'abantu omu bubonero bw'obwesigye bw'ekyanga.
items.accreditation: Okugarukamu okwikiriza abanyamakuru hamwe n'abakugu, n'okuhandiika encwamu z'abarikushwijuma omu kihandiiko ky'okushwijuma.
items.abuse: Okumanya okukwatanisa nari okuhindura emirimo y'okuteera obubonero hamwe n'okurinda omukutu kuruga aha kushisha.
items.accuracy: Okupima n'okutunguura obuhikire bw'ebirugamu omu bwire.

aiSharing.title: AI okushwijuma hamwe n'ebitongore ebindi
aiSharing.body: Okukyebera okushaba nikubaasa kutwariramu okwohereza ekihandiiko kyakyo, nainga okuhindura omu muringo gw'okuhurira nainga vidiyo yaakyo, omu byoma ebirikumanya kandi, ahabw'okugarura obujurizi, omu kitongore ekirikugabwa AI. Eby'amahurire ebi orikuta aha mukutu nibishwijumwa okureeba ngu tihariho obubi bwona bwe birikukorwaho.
aiSharing.review: Ahabw'okuba abamwe aha barikukora ebi barabaasa kushwijuma ebihandiiko aheeru ya Uganda, turiyo nitugaruka kubugana oku ebihandiiko birikurabamu kurugiirira aha Data Protection and Privacy Act, 2019 batakabigire aheeru y'okwombeka ebihandiiko ebirikwetengwa. Ekicweka eki nikiija kuhindurwa obu okugaruka kubugana okwo kurahwa.

dppa.title: Obugabe bwawe ahansi y'ekiragiro ky'okurinda ebihandiiko hamwe n'ebirikukwata aha bantu, 2019
dppa.intro: Nk'omuntu orikukoresa ebihandiiko omu biragiro bya Uganda, oine obugabe bw'okukora ebi:

items.delete: Okushaba okwihaho ebirikukwata aha akawunti yaawe, kurugiirira aha bujunaanizibwa bwaitu oburi ahansi.
items.object: Okuhakanisa, nainga okushaba ngu tukyendeeze, okukora kw'omuringo gwona.
items.complain: Waaba oine eki waakwenda kugamba, ogambe n'ekitongore ekirikujunanizibwa ahaby'amahurire omu Uganda (National Information Technology Authority-Uganda) ku oraabe nooteekateeka ngu tukozeseze kubi amahurire gaawe.

retention.title: Nituguma tukikuumire kumara bwire ki?
retention.body: Ebyarugire omu kushwijuma hamwe n'obuhame bwabyo nibikora ekicweka ky'ebihandiiko by'abantu boona ebirikukyeberwa kandi biragumaho ebiro byona, nk'oku ebyafaayo by'amahurire birikukorwa. Ebirikukwata aha akawunti nibigumibwa obu akawunti yaaba eriho kandi kumara obwire bukye bwanyima y'ekyo, kuhwera omu kucondooza hamwe n'ebihandiiko by'okwikiriza ebirikwetengwa omu muringo gw'okushwijuma. Ebihandiiko ebirikushwijumwa oburogo nibigumibwa kumara obwire obu burikwetengwa kukora encwamu.

cookies.title: Kuki hamwe n'okubiika kw'omwihanga
cookies.body: Nitukoresa akakooki k'omurundi gw'okubanza okukugumya oteireho omukono, hamwe n'okubiika kw'omwihanga kwijuka ekishushani kyawe hamwe n'orurimi oru orikwenda aha kyoma eki. Titurikukoresa ebirikukurataho eby'okuranga eby'ekicweka kya kashatu.

children.title: Obusingye bw'abaana
children.body: Zuula ekateebwaho abarikukoresa abari aha myaka 18 hamwe n'okukiraho. Titurikushorooza amakuru g'abantu kuruga omu baana, kandi nitwija kushazamu goona agu turikumanya.

changes.title: Empindahinduka omu kiragiro eki
changes.body: Nitwija kuhindura ebiro aha mutwe gw'orupapura obu enteekateeka egi erahinduka, kandi tushohore ebihindukire aha <home>omuka</home> batakakozire.

contact.title: Okuhikaana n'okushaba kw'amakuru
contact.body: Email <email>privacy@zuula.ug</email> ahabw'ekibuuzo kyona ekirikukwata aha kiragiro eki nainga okugira obugabe bwawe ahansi y'ekiragiro ky'okurinda ebihandiiko hamwe n'obuhangwa bw'abantu, 2019. Reeba n'aha <terms>Ebikuratirwa omu kukoresa</terms>.

acceptance.title: Okwikiriza ebiragiro ebi
acceptance.body: Okukoresa Zuula — omukutu gwa intaneeti, kandi omu biro by'omumaisho WhatsApp/Telegram bots hamwe na banywani baawe API — noikiriza ebiragiro ebi. Ku oraabe otarikwikiriza, nyabura we otakoresa obuheereza.

service.title: Zuula niki (kandi kitari)
service.body: Zuula neekyebera ebirikugambwa, enkwatanisa hamwe n'eby'amakuru erikukoresa okumanya okw'okwetegyeka hamwe, ahu omushango gurikuhindurwa, okushwijuma kw'abantu kurabira omu bashwijumi abarikwikirizibwa. Encwamu neeyoreka okushwijuma kwaitu okurikukirayo oburungi okw'obujurizi oburiho obu kyashohoziibwe, kandi neebaasa kuhinduka obujurizi burungi bwaba buroho. Zuula n'ekyoma ky'okukyebera amazima, tikiri kya magezi g'ebiragiro, eby'obujanjabi nainga eby'esente, kandi encwamu terikubaasa kuba ekintu ky'okuhindura okusharamu kwawe.

items.roles: Buri omwe naabaasa kwehandikisa nk'omukozesa wa gavumenti. Omurimo gw'omunyamakuru hamwe n'omukugu nigwetenga okwikirizibwa.
items.accurate: Ha omu kuhandiika nainga okushaba akakongi k'okwikirizibwa, ha amakuru agahikire.
items.one: Gira akaunti emwe ahari buri muntu, kandi oteere eby'okukoresa byawe omu kihama — noobaire nookora aha bikwatiraine n'akaunti yaawe.
items.twoFactor: Okukakasa ebintu bibiri nikyetengwa aha akawunti ya Expert na Admin.

submissions.title: Okuhayo kwawe
submissions.body: Oine kuba oine obugabe bw'okugabana ekintu kyona eki orikuhayo kukyeberwa. Otahayo ebirikukwata aha biragiro, ebirikuhenda obusingye bw'omuntu ondiijo, nainga ebi otaine rusa rw'okugabana.
submissions.publish: Ebyahairweyo nibishwijumwa okureeba ngu tihariho obukooko bw'okurwanisa omu by'obuhangwa bwa kompyuta bitakatandikire kushwijuma. Okuheereza hamwe n'ekirugamu Zuula nikibaasa kushohozibwa nk'ekicweka ky'ebihandiiko by'abantu boona ebirikukyebera amazima, omu muringo nigwo gumwe ogu ekitongore ky'amakuru kirikushohoza eki kirikukyebera amazima.

ratings.title: Okushwijuma kw'abantu hamwe n'emigyenzo
ratings.body: Okusharamu okushwijuma omu mazima, kurugirira aha buhame oburikworekwa. Okukwatanisa nainga okuhindura emirimo y'okushwijuma (nk'eky'okureeberaho, guruupu z'ebitabo ebirikushwijuma hamwe kugira ngu zishemeze obubonero bw'okusharamu) nikubaasa kureetera okushwijuma kwabyo kuhakanisibwa kandi n'ebitabo ebirikwejumbamu bikazibirwa. Noobaasa kuhababa ebirikukwata aha bintu nainga okushwijuma okurikureebeka nk'okwahindwirwe kuruga aha rupapura rw'ebihaburo.

api.title: API hamwe n'okuhikwaho kw'omukozesa
api.body: Abanyamakuru hamwe n'ebitabo by'obwebembezi nibibaasa kushaba ebishumuruzo bya API kuruga ahari <keys>Akawunti → API Ebishumuruzo</keys>. Okuhika aha banywani API nikukuratira obwingi bw'okushaba (obwahati {limit} okushaba/kishana) kandi ebishumuruzo bikwatiraine n'akawunti yaawe — otakabigabana. Reeba <dev>orupapura rw'omukozesa</dev> okumanya ebirikukiraho.

ip.title: Ebintu by'obwengye
ip.body: Eiziina Zuula, akamanyiso hamwe n'omukutu biri ebya Centre for Intelligent Technologies, Victoria University Kampala. Nooyakiirwa kugabana, okuteera ekishushani hamwe n'okworeka ebirugire omu kushwijuma kwa Zuula n'okuranga hamwe n'akakwate kugaruka aha ripoota.

disclaimer.title: Obuhikire hamwe n'obugarukiro bw'okujunanwa
disclaimer.body: Nitushwijuma buri kihandiiko omu bwesigwa kandi tukashohoza obuhame oburi enyima ya buri kucwamu, kwonka titurikukakasa ngu okucwamu kwona tikurimu nshobi. Okurugiirira aha biragiro bya Uganda, Zuula hamwe na Victoria University CIT tibarikujunanizibwa ahabw'encwamu ezirikukorwa kurugiirira aha kucwamu.

termination.title: Okwemereza hamwe n'okushazamu
termination.body: Nitubaasa kurekyeraaho nainga kukinga akawunti ahabw'okukoresa kubi, okuhindura obubonero, nainga okuhenda ebiragiro ebi. Noobaasa kukinga akawunti yaawe bwanyima y'obwire bwona kuruga omu ntebeekanisa za Akawunti.

law.title: Ekiragiro ekirikwebembera
law.body: Ebigambo ebi nibikuratira ebiragiro bya Uganda.

changes.title: Empindahinduka omu bigambo ebi
changes.body: Nitubaasa kuhindura ebiragiro ebi nk'oku omukutu gurikukurakurana. Nitwija kuhindura ebiro ebiri ahaiguru twaba nitukikora; okugumizamu kukoresa Zuula bwanyima y'empindahinduka nikimanyisa ngu noikiriza ebiragiro ebihindwirwe.

contact.title: Okuhikaana
contact.body: Ebibuuzo ebirikukwata aha bigambo ebi? Email <email>hello@zuula.ug</email>. Reeba n'ebigambo byaitu <privacy>Ekiragiro ky'obusherekye</privacy>.
